# OVHcloud Go SDK

> The Go client for the OVHcloud API (github.com/ovh/sdk-go): one package per API section under
> pkg/, about 7 000 operations, OAuth2 service-account authentication, typed errors and
> iterators over lists, helpers that wait for asynchronous work, and a read-only mode for
> exploring an account safely. Most of the code is generated from the API's OpenAPI
> specifications.

Before you write a call, look up the method for its route in the operation index: guessing
names from the URL is not reliable.

## Docs

- [Guide](README.md): install, first program, finding an operation, arguments, pagination, waiting for asynchronous work, errors, configuration
- [Agent notes](AGENTS.md): the conventions in short, for AI coding agents
- [Operation index](index/README.md): one index/<section>.jsonl per section, each line a method with its route, Go signature and required IAM actions

## Optional

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): pkg/ is generated, how to report a problem
- [OVHcloud API console](https://api.ovh.com): every route, with its parameters
